[ff6464]Xmas Event has ended.[ffffff]
I didn't expect to see such an establishment in\nthe mountains.
The atmosphere is different from the factory we\nsaw before.
See, I knew something is definitely off.\nI can tell that the Xmas energy isn't being\ntransmitted anywhere at all...
Oh!
Hm?
What's wrong?
Humph!!
Ummm!!
Huhhh!!
Let's talk to him!
Let's just leave him alone.
E-errr...I don't feel like talking to him after\nseeing that tho...
What are you talking about?\nLet's go ask him!
Agree! I'm curious about what he's doing, but...\nHonestly, I dislike that creature.\nLet's just ignore him...
Um?! That voice, is it you, Mr. Shawle?\nOhh, my lady is here too!
Mr. Shawle! Long time no see!
Whoaa!\nI-is this an attack, Velly?!
It's just a greeting!
Dunder, what were you doing here?
As you can see!
Together with my friends at Tomte Pavilion!
We were praying so that the Xmas energy will reach\neach destination safely!
What? So there are still more of this creature?!
Of course! Don't tell me that you thought Dunder\nand I were the only ones who distributed all of\nthe presents?
Besides the place that is assigned to Dunder and\nme, there are still many more in other places.
W-well...\nSo what happened?
The Xmas energy suddenly stopped transmitting for\nunknown reasons. My friends headed out to various\nplaces to spread the news...
And I stay here praying and hoping that the Xmas\nenergy would get transmitted out again.
Aren't you guys the reason why the Xmas energy\nstopped transmitting?
Huh? Why us tho?!
Well, don't be like that...
Anyhow, there's no mistake that the Xmas energy\ncan't be transmitted because something in this\npavilion is off, right?
Xmas energy is being controlled on the top floor\nthough...Dunder, have you checked it?
O-oh, why didn't I think of that before!\nThat's the biggest mistake in my life!
So all you did during an emergency like this was\nposing around?
A-anyhow, let's go check the top floor! If I'm not\nmistaken, there is a trick in the back room that\ncan get us straight to the top floor...
?!\nIt's locked from the inside!! Who the hey did it?
Don't they keep the spare key somewhere?
Actually, there's an emergency key, but it's kept\nsomewhere else and only my clan can use it.\nWe can also take the stairs, though.
I'm gonna go get the key. And just in case, in the\nmeantime, I want you guys to take the stairs and\naim for the top floor!
Fine then, since you've promised to reward us.
Dunder, I want you to stay here.
You can count on me!
Okay, off I go then!!
I'll go with you then!
What?\nDo you really wanna be with me that much?
I just don't like being around that creature!
Okay then, I'll go with Shawle!\nYou guys please try to go up with the stairs!
I can only support you from here and wish you good\nluck!
Ohh, how is it going? All I can do here is\npraying for your safety. We're counting on you!\nThanks!
I've got the key!
Geez, I'm tired.\nYou wouldn't be able to get it if I weren't\nthere...
Did anything happen?\nMy lady, Mr. Shawle.
It was awful! She couldn't reach high places and\nshe kept forgetting stuff and asked me to check\nthem instead...
Y-you've been really helpful.\nThanks for saving the day!
Whew!!
O-okay, there's something more important that I\nwant you to know. Do you know about a cat called\nYule Cat?
Huh? What is it?
Hmm, that's weird.\nThat means that Yule Cat thing isn't trying to\ninterrupt Xmas celebrations?
I don't know about that cat either.\nBut then at the end of the day, it's still getting\nin the way.
Anyway, you brought the key, right?\nLet's just ask that thing directly!
